lesson: Find the spectrum of the already constructed pulse signal

objects.Sf: Spectrum S(f) of that same transmitted signal

pulse-response.statement: H(f)=T exp(-j pi f T) sinc(f T)
conditions: Unit causal pulse on 0<t<T; normalized sinc

complete-spectrum.statement: S is the product of the established sample spectrum and pulse response
conditions: Retain complex pulse phase and sampling gain

states.purpose: Build frequency views from the known time-domain objects
states.why: The product is known but its two factors still need values
We need the first factor of the product

states.purpose: Shift and add spectral copies, with the corresponding derivation adjacent
states.why: Compute the first factor rather than introduce a disconnected identity

states.purpose: Fill the sample-spectrum factor on the same process
states.why: Only the pulse-response factor remains unresolved

states.purpose: Inspect the existing pulse and its transform
states.why: We need the second factor before completing S

states.purpose: Obtain the pulse response with its phase and zero locations
states.why: Relate the visible pulse to the factor that shapes the copies

states.purpose: Show both known factors on the same process
states.why: The product can now be evaluated

states.purpose: Multiply the known factors to obtain S
states.why: This resolves the spectrum of the same transmitted signal
